products.title: Arrival 10 Novara Laminate Wood Plank Flooring - High Density Fiberboard
products.body_html:
Arrival® 10, our water resistant laminate flooring, brings exceptional style and extreme durability to high-traffic residential and moderate commercial projects in a click lock/floating design. With an impressive 10mm overall thickness, attached acoustical cushion for quiet comfy steps, and an AC4 rating, our latest addition is ready to rumble.
